exposure: Obese women vs. women of normal weight
cohort: 2,652 pregnant Omani women who delivered at the Royal Hospital, Muscat, Oman, between November 2011 and April 2012
finding: Obese pregnant Omani women had a significantly increased risk of various maternal antenatal complications, intrapartum and postpartum events, and neonatal complications.
mod_finding: Obese women had a significantly increased incidence of Caesarean delivery (RR: 1.48; 95% CI: 1.08-2.03; P <0.01).
